newsitem.title: UK: SBC to buy Yorkshire Water 'B' shares.
newsitem.headline: SBC to buy Yorkshire Water 'B' shares.

text.p: SBC Warburg said on Monday it would buy back B shares in Yorkshire Water Plc at 36 pence each in accordance with the buyback plan announced in January.
SBC said it would repurchase 366,668,092 shares at or around 1100 GMT today, representing around 89 percent of the B shares in issue. All the shares repurchased will be cancelled.

SBC said Yorkshire Water had also decided to extend a free dealing facility allowing remaining B shareholders to sell their entire holding of B shares at 36 pence per share. SBC, as the agent for Yorkshire Water, would repurchase the shares on March 27.
